name: test-skills
description: Tests that can fail: skills for every kind of testing, from unit and property-based to exploration, accessibility, visual, performance and LLM evals, plus audit, guard and mutation checks.

interface.longDescription: Plan, write and verify unit, component, integration, end-to-end, property-based, exploration, accessibility, visual, performance, security and LLM tests, then prove they can fail with an audit, a weakening guard and mutants.
defaultPrompt: Audit the tests in this repository and prove they can fail.
